verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents approval workflows for job postings, requisitions, or offers. The only nearby items are generic claims of 'Custom, flexible configurations' and Automation Hub's routine tasks (archiving, tagging, emailing, advancing candidates), and neither describes routing openings or offers through configurable approval chains before they go live or are sent.

support.subject: As an operations lead, job openings and offers route through configurable approval chains before anything goes live or gets sent
